Two large mature vessel elements form one continuous hollow lignified tube, their thick golden cell walls showing pits and an open perforation plate. The conducting vessel lumen has NO nucleus or living protoplasm. Beside it, several much smaller living parenchyma cells have delicate cytoplasm and a visible small nucleus inside each cell wall.
